claim.quote: We show first data recorded during a single-phase commissioning run in 2015 (ArDM Run I), which overall confirm the good and stable performance of the ton-scale LAr detector.

key_value.quote: With an active target of 850 kg

name: The ArDM Liquid Argon Time Projection Chamber at the Canfranc Underground Laboratory: a ton-scale detector for Dark Matter Searches

summary.plain: The ArDM collaboration's description of its detector installed at Canfranc, with first data from the 2015 single-phase run showing good and stable performance.
summary.technical: Detector paper: liquid argon TPC with an 850 kg active target installed underground at LSC; first data from the single-phase commissioning run in 2015 (ArDM Run I).

title: The ArDM Liquid Argon Time Projection Chamber at the Canfranc Underground Laboratory: a ton-scale detector for Dark Matter Searches
why_it_matters: The standard reference for the ArDM apparatus at Canfranc.
